summary.text: Single Thought Endless Clones is Purple Mountain True Monarch's immortal killer move. It conceals the true body among purple silhouettes that multiply rapidly.

claims.text: On cloud soil in Lang Ya blessed land, Fang Yuan finds Purple Mountain True Monarch’s killer move similar to using myriad self and familiar face to hide among strength path phantoms. This is one move with those two effects, so it expends less immortal essence. The purple silhouettes also multiply faster than strength path phantoms, but they have no offensive power and exist purely for concealment, unlike the phantoms. A few dozen purple silhouettes become several hundred thousand in a few breaths, and his true body cannot be found among them without a powerful investigative killer move.

When the formation path space around an immemorial myriad head coiling dragon breaks, Ying Wu Xie recognizes single thought endless clones. Fang Yuan is everywhere: he conceals himself among countless silhouettes, and the immemorial dragon head has no way to figure out where he is, so its battle strength is useless until it changes target.

When Divine Bean Palace, two immemorial soul beasts, and two rank seven demonic path Gu Immortals assault him in green ghost desert, Fang Yuan activates the move in one try. Dozens of blue light silhouettes emerge from his body and scatter, then keep splitting, one into four and four into ten, until they form a huge blue silhouette army with his true body hidden among them. The original version created purple light silhouettes. Fang Yuan changed it by adding countless sneak attack Gu, which turn the silhouettes blue and give their movement some sneakiness. Divine Bean Palace shatters the blue shadows like bursting bubbles wherever it passes, and Eagle Concubine and Old Ghost Bai Jun lose their attack target. When Divine Bean Palace is about to crash into him, reverse flow protection seal is not ready yet. After the palace collides with the winged black python, he uses that chance to activate reverse flow protection seal, then in a flash uses single thought endless clones again while activating familiar face, turning into a blue shadow and mixing in among them.

Known users.text: Purple Mountain True Monarch Fang Yuan
